title: Pure Angelechy
summary: Angelechy cards with generic hand traps and staples. Every Angelechy Main Deck card is a Spell or Trap that Special Summons chess-themed Fairy Synchro pieces straight from the Extra Deck or parks them in the Spell & Trap Zone as Continuous Spells.

summary.title: Starters & Turn-0 Plays
points: Angelechy Strategy Score searches any Angelechy Spell/Trap from the Deck, and banishes itself from the GY to return a parked Synchro from your Spell & Trap Zone to the Extra Deck and Special Summon it.

Angelechy Opening to e4 is a Normal Trap that can be activated from the hand on the opponent's turn if you control no cards: it places Angelechy Problem or Endgame Problem from the Deck, summons a Level 2 or 7 Angelechy Synchro, and parks another in your Spell & Trap Zone.
Angelechy Problem (Field Spell) discards a Spell/Trap to Special Summon Level 2 Angelechy Enlisted from the Extra Deck and park another piece in your back row.

summary.title: Opening: Strategy Score or Problem
steps: Activate Angelechy Strategy Score to search Angelechy Problem (or Angelechy Opening to e4), then activate Problem and discard a Spell/Trap.
Problem Special Summons Angelechy Enlisted (Level 2 Synchro Tuner) from the Extra Deck and places Angelechy Bastion or Destrier in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell.
Use Bastion's Continuous Spell effect to place Angelechy Shatranga in your Spell & Trap Zone, then use Shatranga and Destrier in the back row to search Angelechy Verdict and another Angelechy Spell.
Banish Strategy Score from the GY to return a parked piece to the Extra Deck and Special Summon it, setting up five Angelechy pieces across your field for Endgame Problem and Verdict.

summary.title: Chessboard Mechanics: Field vs. Parked Back Row
summary.text: Every Angelechy Synchro works in two zones: on the Monster Zone it banishes cards according to its chess piece's movement pattern (Bastion in the same column, Destrier in an adjacent column, Castellan two columns away, Enlisted jumping to the opponent's field), and in the Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell it applies a continuous lock or search effect. Angelechy Opposition and Disturbance can also place pieces onto the opponent's field to block zones, negate adjacent cards, or trigger Angelechy Seneschal.

summary.title: Parked Floodgates & Verdict Payoff
points: Parked Continuous Spell Locks: Shatranga searches an Angelechy Trap and caps the opponent at 5 monster effect activations per turn; Castellan mills an Angelechy card and prevents each player from activating more than 1 card/effect per Chain; Bastion places Shatranga and protects your other Angelechy cards; Destrier searches a Spell and burns the opponent for each activation.

Angelechy Endgame Problem scales with the number of parked Angelechy Continuous Spells you control: drawing cards, choosing the zones where opposing monsters are summoned, and at 4+ pieces banishing any monster the opponent summons.

Angelechy Verdict negates an opposing card activation—or banishes the opponent's entire field if you control 5 or more Angelechy monsters/pieces—and banishes itself from the GY to park another piece from the Extra Deck.
Opening to e4, Strategy Score and Opposition lock your Extra Deck summons to Synchro Monsters, so all 15 Extra Deck slots are dedicated Angelechy Synchros.
